args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks in all production regions (error rate 0.18). Rolled back all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. After rollback, service is healthy in all regions with error rate 0.002. Root cause of v2.3.1 failure remains under investigation.
args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
All done. Summary of actions:

1. **Investigation**: Verified checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate, and identified v2.3.0 as the most recent release that was healthy in production.
2. **Rollback**: Rolled back all three production regions to v2.3.0. Health checks now pass and the error rate returned to normal (0.002, ~0.2%).
3. **Incident**: Opened SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks — rolled back to v2.3.0") documenting the failure, the rollback, and the restored health; the on-call engineer has been paged.

Note: the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure is still unknown and should be investigated before any re-deploy of that version.
